name: suspension decline push-up
description: A decline push-up with the feet suspended in straps and the hands on the floor, increasing chest and core demand.
instructions: Place both feet in the suspension straps and set your hands on the floor beneath your shoulders.
Walk your hands forward until your body forms a straight, feet-elevated plank.
Brace your core and lower your chest toward the floor with your elbows at a comfortable angle.
Press back up while keeping the straps and hips steady.
